governance.external_download_scope: Only the seven exact artifacts and immutable URLs in proposed_model_acquisition_bundle, maximum 663933265 bytes; no substitutions.
governance.local_user_evidence_scope: Read-only, private, non-retained processing of only nxmmr-local-sample-video and nxmmr-local-pakistan-plate-images; originals remain untouched and no raw identifiers enter Git or retained stores.
governance.ground_truth_rule: No model output may be reused as its own oracle. Real-world labels require an independent human or publisher ground truth.
governance.promotion_rule: A model or operation is promoted only after representative REAL_WORLD_CERTIFIED evidence and integrated PRODUCT_CERTIFIED acceptance.
governance.privacy_rule: Sensitive media stays local, is not committed, and is reported only through aggregate or redacted results.
governance.suggestion_rule: Ordinary visible suggestions require PRODUCT_CERTIFIED operation status.

benchmark_resource_policy.measured_admission_rule: After a representative measurement exists, require expected incremental peak RAM plus at least 1610612736 bytes headroom, never below the class floor unless a receipt contains an explicit evidence-based justification.
benchmark_resource_policy.video_policy: Stream or bound frames; never decode the full video into memory.

hardware_envelope.deployment_build_resource_policy: The existing separate 6 GiB build/deployment gate remains unchanged and is not authorized by this manifest.
